landing.hero_title: Transform your company management into an intelligent control center.
landing.hero_subtitle: Nexxus connects administration, employees, tasks, attendance, payroll, wellbeing, and AI in a premium SaaS platform to operate with clarity and speed.
landing.section_system_h2: A platform to operate people, processes, and decisions.

landing.value_auto_desc: Workflows that eliminate repetitive tasks and keep the administrator informed.

landing.value_ai_desc: AI to detect risk, summarize workdays, and prioritize what matters.
landing.section_modules_h2: The entire business stack in one single experience.
landing.section_modules_p: Each module was designed for the operation to be measurable, auditable, and easy to scale.
landing.section_admin_p: The administrator gets a business cockpit: metrics, permissions, payroll, audit, reports, automations, and team monitoring from a premium view.

landing.ops_audit_desc: History of actions, critical changes, and traceability per user.
landing.ops_data_desc: Users, tasks, payments, documents, and check-ins connected by company.
landing.ops_workflows_desc: Approval flows for requests, support, absences, and tasks.
landing.ops_docs_desc: Document center for contracts, certificates, payroll, and internal policies.
landing.section_impl_h2: Ready to connect to the rhythm of your operation.
landing.section_impl_p: Designed to coexist with existing processes: HR, reports, communication, documents, and executive boards.
landing.section_plans_h2: Scale from a team to a whole organization.
landing.section_ai_h2: Automations that understand your company's pulse.
landing.section_ai_p: Nexxus AI summarizes workdays, detects overload, anticipates HR risks, and turns scattered data into actionable decisions.
landing.testimonial_quote: Nexxus turns daily administration into a measurable, elegant, and ready-to-grow operation.
landing.final_cta_h2: Your company doesn't need more loose sheets. It needs a living system.
landing.final_cta_p: Activate Nexxus and turn your operation into an intelligent, auditable, and ready-to-scale platform.

landing.module_payroll_desc: Calculate payments, bonuses and deductions with full transparency and traceability.

landing.module_chat_desc: Internal communication connected to tasks and projects to stay focused.

saberMas.subtitle: Advanced synergy between predictive AI and human support to eliminate burnout and empower talent.
saberMas.vision_text: Our vision is to transform global work culture, making mental health the engine of business success. We create environments where human talent thrives in balance, reducing turnover and exhaustion.
saberMas.mission_text: We fuse cutting-edge AI with expert support to detect stress and fatigue patterns in real-time. Our mission is to prevent crises before they affect productivity and wellbeing, connecting collaborators with effective self-care tools.
saberMas.pillar_1_text: We implement military-grade encryption and advanced anonymization protocols. We guarantee a safe space, protecting your information at all times.
saberMas.pillar_2_text: Advanced models that analyze fatigue and stress patterns, allowing mitigation of exhaustion before it becomes a performance crisis.
saberMas.pillar_3_text: Technology paves the way, but connection is real. We have a network of empathetic professionals ready to provide comprehensive support.
saberMas.pillar_4_text: Real-time organizational health metrics that provide deep visibility to build effective, human-talent-centered strategies.
saberMas.why_text: While others only measure results, we care for their origin: the people. Nexxus ensures your company's growth goes hand in hand with the comprehensive wellbeing of each collaborator.
